translation: Krishnadas Maharaj lived in Aglod, but he passed away at Sabalpur, at his daughter's home; hence today there is a tulsi-kyaro of Krishnadas Maharaj at Sabalpur. In recent times, his relatives, residents of Ahmedabad, have had this garden grandly renovated and have appointed a caretaker there. Next to it stands a school building. Thus this Sabalpur is a sacred site.
